text:
jordana: Drafting the pilot "slate" recruitment + acceptance gates. Top-level asks: 1) 9-11 partners mixed verticals, 2) onboarding completion >= 70% within 12 days, 3) daily eval harness for 14 days, 4) structured triage -> Product/ML/Runtime. Feedback?
priya: Love it. Ops constraints: cap active heavy partners to 3 until autoscale smoke is green. Also require partners to provide a 6-point workload profile (avg RPS, peak RPS, typical seq, max seq, embedding usage, tool calls).
connor: I'll own the workload profile template + a lightweight adapter to convert partner examples into the eval harness format. We should require a minimum of 8 canonical prompts covering: short, long, tool-call, structured-json, embeddings.
isabel: Legal/security: intake needs a PII toggle. If toggled, partner goes to "private-preview" lane: DPA + KMS provisioning + Ops checklist before credits. No credits until legal sign-off.
devops-bot: intake form -> https://internal.redwood/apply/pilot-slate — auto-tags: vertical, region, private_request.
priya: Metrics for go/no-go: cohort median NPS >=6/10 at day14, at least 50% of partners with daily tokens >=400, daily eval pass-rate >= 85% across canonical prompts, and zero P0s for 5 consecutive days post-onboard.
jordana: Rollout gates: soft private preview at >=3 green partners; full private preview at >=9 with NPS + eval thresholds met. Rollback: repeatable P1 within 48h -> canary rollback + postmortem.
connor: Instrumentation required before acceptance: traces (distributed trace ID), p50/p95 latency, kv-cache hit-rate, batching stats, GPU util, and embedding similarity drift. Add an eval harness that posts metrics to partner workspace daily.
isabel: Incentives: tier A (strategic): $2k credits + Dedicated trial; tier B: $1k credits + 3 months priority support. Legal gates credits until DPA.
priya: Feedback routing automation: simple keyword rules + tag-based routing. e.g. ("accuracy","regression") -> ML; ("latency","timeout","oom") -> eng-runtime; ("docs","confusing") -> Product. Weekly digest to #pilot-slate-feedback.
jordana: Responsibilities: Growth runs recruitment/outreach, Connor builds harness, Priya handles infra gating + autoscale validation, Isabel handles legal/KMS, I'll run partner kickoff + weekly syncs and own the pilot roadmap doc.
devops-bot: Reminder: complete the intake form before scheduling kickoff.
jordana: I'll update the pilot slate doc and post recruitment copy in Growth channel by EOD. :rocket:
